brief_summary: Four-panel numbered process strip showing the per-switch Holee mod procedure: opening the switch housing with a switch opener, cutting a small foam pad, seating the pad with tweezers around the stem base, and closing the housing followed by a hand test of the stroke. Caption emphasizes the procedure repeats once per switch with no batch step.
data_sources: holee-mod-explained.mdx § 'Materials and the actual procedure' — 'The procedure, per switch: open the housing with a switch opener, lift the stem out and set it aside with the spring still seated if possible, cut a small foam pad sized to the target zone, seat the pad with tweezers, replace the stem, and snap the housing closed. Test the switch by hand'

holee-mod-explained.mdx § 'The time cost is the whole story' — 'There is no version of this mod that is a quick afternoon project on a whole keyboard.' (grounds the 'repeat once per switch — there is no batch step' caption)
